mechanism: Diltiazem may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism and reduce ethambutol clearance; ethambutol can cause optic neuritis which may be exacerbated by diltiazem's potential effects on ocular perfusion.
action: Monitor renal function closely and ethambutol serum levels if available; assess visual acuity at baseline and periodically; dose adjustment of ethambutol may be necessary in renal impairment.
